title: Black Lagoon
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Japanese salaryman Rokuro 'Rock' Okajima is taken hostage by modern-day pirates, then abandoned by his company and joins them. The Lagoon Company, led by Dutch with gunfighter Revy and mechanic Benny, smuggles goods around Southeast Asia from Roanapur, a Thai port city run by Russian, Chinese, Italian and Colombian syndicates. Jobs spiral into gunfights, naval battles and gang wars, and Rock drifts deeper into the city's morality.
life_message: It holds up no clear good life; it asks how far an ordinary person can sink into a world where violence is the only law.
